title: 拉扎德策略师：中国AI成本优势，但股东回报存疑
speaker: Ron Temple

segments.en: because I do think over time, users of AI, I think enterprise users and even individuals are going to be looking for reliable AI, that's inexpensive. And in many cases, Chinese AI looks like it's better positioned to within that market share.
segments.zh: 因为我认为随着时间的推移，AI用户——企业用户甚至个人——会寻找可靠且便宜的AI。在很多情况下，中国AI似乎更有能力占据这一市场份额。

segments.en: Does that mean you're better off looking for alpha in the Chinese AI and tech space? And are we seeing sort of everything else, Korea, Taiwan, in the US, perhaps more of a beta play?
segments.zh: 这是否意味着在中国AI和科技领域寻找超额收益更好？而其他地区——韩国、台湾、美国——可能更多是贝塔行情？

segments.en: You know, I'm not sure I'm ready to say the Chinese providers will be the best way for a shareholder to make money. And this is one of those big challenges, maybe I should zoom back out. No mistake. I think AI is going to be revolutionary from an economic perspective. It will be ubiquitous.
segments.zh: 我不确定是否可以说中国供应商是股东赚钱的最佳途径。这是一个大挑战。但毫无疑问，AI将从经济角度带来革命性变化，它将无处不在。
